Class ClientMessageVisitorImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.visitors.ClientMessageVisitorImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientMessageVisitor, GameMessageVisitor
public class ClientMessageVisitorImpl extends Object implements ClientMessageVisitor
Concrete implementation of ClientMessageVisitor.

Handles all messages received from a client by delegating game-related actions to a GameMessageVisitor and session-related actions (login, lobby, ranking) directly to the MatchManager.
